# definednet_role (Resource)

Manages a role. Roles carry the inbound firewall rules applied to every host assigned to them.

The API does not support renaming a role, so changing `name` replaces the resource. Deleting a role that still has hosts assigned fails with `ERR_HAS_DEPENDENTS`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "definednet_role" "admin" {
  name        = "admin"
  description = "Operators with SSH access everywhere"
}

resource "definednet_role" "web" {
  name = "web"

  firewall_rules = [
    {
      protocol    = "TCP"
      description = "https from anyone"
      port_range  = { from = 443, to = 443 }
    },
    {
      protocol        = "TCP"
      description     = "ssh from admins in prod"
      allowed_role_id = definednet_role.admin.id
      allowed_tags    = ["env:prod"]
      port_range      = { from = 22, to = 22 }
    },
    {
      protocol        = "ANY"
      description     = "anything between web servers"
      allowed_role_id = "self" # Terraform cannot reference definednet_role.web.id from inside itself
    },
    {
      protocol = "ICMP"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name, 1-50 characters. Changing it forces a new role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description, at most 255 characters.
- `firewall_rules` (Attributes Set) Inbound firewall rules applied to hosts with this role. `allowed_role_id = "self"` allows hosts with this same role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--firewall_rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Role ID, e.g. `role-LO4SPDSWTZNJC676WFCZKUB3ZQ`.

<a id="nestedatt--firewall_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `firewall_rules`

Required:

- `protocol` (String) Allowed protocol: `ANY`, `TCP`, `UDP`, or `ICMP`.

Optional:

- `allowed_role_id` (String) Only hosts with this role are allowed. Null allows every role. `self` means this role itself and is the only accepted spelling of its own `id`, which Terraform cannot reference from inside the role.
- `allowed_tags` (Set of String) Only hosts carrying every one of these `key:value` tags are allowed. Null allows any tags. An empty set means the same thing to the API as null and is always reported back as null, so it is rejected to keep the plan and refreshed state in agreement.
- `description` (String) Optional description, at most 255 characters.
- `port_range` (Attributes) Inclusive port range. Null allows every port. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--firewall_rules--port_range))

<a id="nestedatt--firewall_rules--port_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `firewall_rules.port_range`

Required:

- `from` (Number) First port in the range (1-65535).
- `to` (Number) Last port in the range (1-65535), at least `from`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import definednet_role.web role-LO4SPDSWTZNJC676WFCZKUB3ZQ
```
